Nina (CSM): Heads-up—Cobalt's QBR Friday. Spotted a sudden embeddings surge tied to their new recommendations feed. Need a one-slide incident + mitigation asks.
Ken (FinOps): 7d spike +130%. Baseline month ~$12.5k -> if sustained ~$29k. Running 30d sensitivity.
quota-bot: Alert: account cobalt-prod exceeded soft threshold (daily $4.6k) at 2026-05-10T17:12Z.
Ollie (Solutions Eng): Quick wins: 1) batch embeddings, 2) switch non-UI flows to emb-small, 3) try dim 512->256 for a subset. Can include sample curl snippet for batching.
Ravi (Onboarding): I'll request top-500 queries + 1k call sample and schedule a 30m enablement. Can we pre-send a short checklist?
Ken (FinOps): Propose short-term plays for QBR: a) soft cap = avg*1.2, hard cap = avg*2, b) 3-day credit offset for campaign, c) move analytics to nightly batch. Estimated mitigated month ~$18.5k.
Nina (CSM): Good. Ollie/Ken—please provide 2-slide backup: technical plays + numbers. Ravi—book enablement for Wed 11am PT and request samples in the invite.
Cobalt Admin: Confirmed - we'll pull query logs and assign an engineer for the enablement. Insights feature launched May 8.
Ollie (Solutions Eng): Quick curl example to show in enablement:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
[...batch payload...]
```
Nina (CSM): Action items: Ken -> final forecast + credit rec (EOD). Ollie -> playbook + savings estimates (EOD). Ravi -> enablement invite + collect samples. I'll draft the QBR slide and circulate tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
Ken (FinOps): Noted. I'll flag renewal risk if runrate stays >2x baseline for 30d and add sensitivity scenarios.
Nina (CSM): Closing loop—will share deck link here. Thanks everyone. :pray:
